name: ceo-inbox-read
description: Read a specific email message OR draft from the CEO's personal inbox, returning both plain text and HTML body. Pass message_id for a received message, or draft_id (from ceo-inbox-list/ceo-inbox-search scoped to DRAFTS) to read a draft's full content before editing it. Intended for use by the ceo-inbox agent — accesses the CEO's personal email, do not call from other agents.

inputs.message_id: string? (Nylas message ID to fetch — provide exactly one of message_id or draft_id)
inputs.draft_id: string? (Nylas draft ID to fetch the full draft body before editing — provide exactly one of message_id or draft_id)

outputs.subject: string
outputs.attachments: array of { id, filename, contentType, size } (messages only; non-inline file attachments; pass id + message id to ceo-inbox-download-attachment)
outputs.is_draft: boolean (true when a draft was read; absent for messages)
